title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
summary: On Monday, benchmark indices saw a downturn, erasing a brief recovery. title: NSE exit triggers sharp slowdown in unlisted share trading
summary: Following the National Stock Exchange's recent listing, the unlisted share market has encountered a substantial reduction in trading activity, with brokers reporting nearly a 50% drop in average daily transactions.
